programme.desc: Scarlett Bailey is presented with the opportunity of a lifetime to work as a pastry chef in one of NYC's top restaurants. Her life gets put on hold when she returns to her hometown for her sister Maddie's wedding.

programme.title: Two Chefs and a Wedding Cake
programme.desc: At her sister's wedding, a food critic meets a chef known for excluding food reviewers entry to his restaurant and must find a way to reconcile their differences.

programme.title: Family Over Everything
programme.desc: After being set up to get jumped, West now owes the biggest Street hustler in Syracuse, Gunzo $50,000. But when Gunzo's crew shows up at West's family home, his older sibling's step in to protect the family from his wrath.

programme.title: Dangerous Thirst
programme.desc: When Royelle's husband, Trevion, proposes delving into the swinging lifestyle, she reluctantly agrees, igniting a tumultuous sexual journey. What starts as a tantalizing exploration of their desires soon transforms into a journey fraught with jealousy, distrust, and emotional turmoil, threatening to unravel the very fabric of their marriage as she begins to find herself in a sex scandal, engulfed by lies, betrayal, and murder.

programme.title: The Perfect Mother
programme.desc: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son Ahmad amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband Jeremy. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance inadvertently leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody. Linda rises to the challenge of overcoming adversary to reunite her family and save her son.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that's connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what's right.

programme.title: Played in My Face
programme.desc: Tonya's life is almost picture perfect, and a wedding on the horizon to the man of her dreams, Victor. One night she receives an anonymous email exposing Victor at a hotel on the same night he claimed to be away on business. Her quiet suspicion spirals into obsession as she discovers that Victor's betrayal runs deeper than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Threaded Lies
programme.desc: When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything. As paranoia sets in, Dante must confront the lies he's built his success on before they destroy him.

programme.title: Hostile Takedown
programme.desc: 9 years ago Alex, a former cop, lost his partner Dennis, when he was assassinated execution style to a vicious murderer. Unable to cope, Alex resigns from the force and finds himself dealing with past ghosts and the guilt he feels for his fallen partner. But when a madman takes over a local mall where Alex is shopping, and threatens the lives of innocent victims, Alex is forced back to his former duties and quickly learns the madman has ties to his slain partner. Will justice be served?

programme.title: DIRT
programme.desc: Derek "Dirt" Roberts is the top lieutenant for Big Boss, a criminal mastermind who rose through the ranks from a "corner boy" to become the city's most powerful organized criminal. When the two grow apart, Dirt hatches an elaborate plan to leave the organization. This plan is interrupted when he comes face to face with Clutch, a rogue detective on a mission to find and rescue his partner and clear his name.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A group of kids stumble across something unfamiliar, and have no idea of the adventure that awaits them. When the games begin the eye chooses its course.

programme.title: Great Gain
programme.desc: Isaac is a janitor whose livelihood is in jeopardy when his boss tries to cut his job in order to save money. When it seems he has finally gotten the best of Isaac, a misunderstanding at a convenience store puts a winning lottery ticket in Isaac's hands. Isaac purchases the company in attempts to get back at Henry for the troubles he caused at work. Isaac's world has been turned around but after gaining so much he may be on the edge of losing it all.

programme.title: Soulful and Funny Episode 6 Mo City
programme.desc: Continuing our tour of Missouri City in Houston, Texas, Crystal takes us to Micheaux's a local restaurant that made a name for themselves during the pandemic by giving back to the community through their "Everybody Eats" program. Owner Mr. Mischeaux serves up traditional southern Louisiana family recipes that include their signature Salmon, Five Cheese Macaroni & Cheese, and Peach Cobbler.

programme.title: Three of a Kind
programme.desc: Three years after graduation, college friends Hope, Chanta, and May - once inseparable - eagerly reunite for Hope's wedding to her fiancé, Robert. What begins as a joyous occasion to celebrate and reminisce soon unravels. As the weekend unfolds, a shocking secret emerges, revealing an unforeseen and devastating link between them. When the truth comes to light, the celebration descends into chaos, leaving their once-unbreakable bond shattered and their lives irrevocably altered.

programme.title: Broken Buckets
programme.desc: After serving 17 years in prison, Travis Cane returns home to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family. But his once bright son, Dontae is acting out and abandoned his goals in basketball for a life on the streets. Hoping to repair their relationship, they work out their struggles on the court.

programme.title: Beautifully Insecure
programme.desc: Imagine falling in love with someone but not being able to love yourself. Leanna was diagnosed with Alopecia at age 7 and by 9 years of age all of her hair was gone. By her early 20's her insecurities had such a grip on her heart that she became a master of hiding her hair loss. It wasn't until she met Terrence, the love of her life, that she felt she couldn't hide it any longer. As their love grew, the pressure to tell Terrence about her hair loss did also.

programme.title: A Christmas Family Secret
programme.desc: Joan believed that being a successful lawyer was the most important thing in her life. She became a successful lawyer at the sacrifice of not seeing or speaking to her father for three years after an argument. When she decides to surprise her father during his favorite holiday, Christmas, she comes back home to one surprise after another. So many she falls in love!

programme.title: Single Bells
programme.desc: Down on their luck, the Bell sisters find themselves single during the holiday season and losing their family restaurant. Hoping to rebuild, the sisters create weekend holiday single mixers that include great food, dancing and unexpected romance.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us
programme.desc: Marcus falls in love with Jessica, who has her own house and wants to start a family. Shortly after their honeymoon, Jessica's past life comes back in to the present. When Jessica's long lost husband reappears back in her life, and wants his family back. Marcus and Jessica are not willing to give up their new life, but her ex-husband is determined to win her back, even if it means risking his life.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: The Vault

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Leverage
programme.desc: In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: German Jets and Destroyers
programme.desc: Three years after the end of WW1, civil aviation was permitted in Germany and names that were later to spearhead military aircraft production emerged. Names such as Messerschmittt, Heinkel and Yunkers. This documentary discusses the rise of the top German Jets and Destroyers used in battle during WW2.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David reveals true stories of unbelievable heroism in World War II, in a world of cold-blooded assassins, crack saboteurs, elite commandos, playboy spies, super-villains and femmes fatales.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: A documented report of Communist atrocities in Korea, with scenes just released depicting the horror and brutality of Communism. Includes interviews with returned prisoners of war who were eye witnesses to some of these atrocities and Major General William Dean and General Mark W. Clark.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Fatal Liaison - The Strange Affair of Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: In 1943, the Axis was on the defensive everywhere. In 1944, The Allies strength would grow in the East, and in the Soviet Union with the opening of the second front.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: April 16, 1917, for the first time in history, French tanks fight their way through the black sludge of Chemin des Dames. One year before, in October, British tanks tried their luck in Somme. In both cases, the long-awaited miracle did not take place. Yet, a century later, the tanks are still here, monsters of technology that are becoming increasingly efficient.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: The SS: A Barbaric State
programme.desc: Among the defendants are the Führer's closest surviving accomplices. But not only them: defendant number 27 is not even a man. It is an entire organization: the SS were a state within the state - which ruled all the police - with its own army, within the Nazi regime.

programme.title: German Armour: The Panzer III
programme.desc: It was Heinz Guderian who in 1934, gave specifications for 2 frontline tanks to be manufactured. The first was intended to be the main battle tank of the Panzer divisions capable of destroying enemy tanks. It was called the Panzer 3. Crewed by 5 men, its weight varied at around 20 tons during the campaign in the west, and achieved a top speed of 25 mph. Its main armament was a 37 mm canon.

programme.title: U.X.B. Unexploded Bomb Disposal WWII England
programme.desc: A fascinating British Military Training Film dealing with the reconnaissance, identification, and reporting of unexploded bombs or U.X.B. during WWII. A interesting time capsule showing the horrors or The Blitz.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst enemy forces gathering, a Luftwaffe squadron guards above, raising suspicions of troop relocation. A pilot's sacrifice, underwater tanks, and strategists' debates add to tensions. The mission is to destroy the enemy crossing without battles. Pilots reflect on their future amid potential encirclement and lack of aviation devices.

programme.title: Project 949
programme.desc: The mysterious sinking, the causes and the salvage operations are revealed of the K-141, Kursk. The Kursk was a Project 949A submarine of the Oscar-class. During the Cold War, The Soviet Navy had to face the challenge of NATO's powerful maritime fleets. The Soviets then discreetly launched Project 949, a top secret program for the construction of a new generation of missile carrying submarines.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: When Hitler claimed restitution of Sudetenland, France and Britain abandoned their ally. Ignoring offers to help defend the Czechs, French leaders met with Hitler in Munich in Sep. 1938. Hitler performed like a statesmen, and French leaders signed a treaty that was in fact a death warrant for their own countries. Hitler felt that the floodgates were open and the wave became unstoppable.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The Fall of France

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: Little more than 20 years after the guns fell silent, they roar back into life. Hitler annexes all of Czechoslovakia. Britain and France respond with promises to Poland.

programme.title: The Ace's War
programme.desc: Winter 1914. The first world conflict is becoming bogged down in the trenches. From now on, the war will no longer be solely on the ground. It will also be in the air. But the beginnings are difficult.

programme.title: Weapons of War: Combat on the Russian Front
programme.desc: Documentary charting the battles waged on the Russian Front in the Second World War. The events which occurred are seen by some as the most barbaric conflict in human history

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The conquest of Italy from the Allied invasion through the various battles.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: During the war with the Soviet Union, 35mm color footage was used for Nazi propaganda. Hitler's pilot filmed his visit to the front lines. Meanwhile, Hollywood director John Ford captured stunning color scenes in North Africa. A camera crew, sent by President Roosevelt, recorded the 1943 Casablanca Conference, where the Allies demanded the unconditional surrender of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Gustav and Gothic Lines- Battle for Italy
programme.desc: A look at the Battle of the Gothic Line from an American Soldier and a soldier from the German Wehrmacht. Also features bonus footage of the Battle Of The Bulge.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: Propaganda
programme.desc: There are many weapons of war; fighter planes, heavy tanks and skilled infantrymen but it could be argued that none is more powerful than the power of suggestion. Propaganda and the war of words played an undoubtedly vital role in both the successes and failures of WW2. Governments struggled to gain the upper hand. But one Nazi proved to have a deft talent for spin. Joseph Goebbels.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: His fleet of U-boats killed thousands and sunk millions of tons of ships and supplies. His career spanned the depths of the ocean to the leader of a nation. At Nuremberg he was charged with piracy and murder as a Nazi War Criminal, and yet escaped the hangman. His story is now told, by both the historians and by the personal statements of those who served with him.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: In the early 1480s, Leonardo Da Vinci designed an aerial screw. Its intended use was unknown, yet served as the inspiration for the helicopter. Developments over the years have seen the Helicopter becoming more involved in troop transport, including airlifting the wounded directly to hospitals. Today's attack Helicopters show the versatility of this war machine.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: From snake-infested jungles to treacherous underground tunnel complexes to city streets, U.S. Infantrymen had to fight in all terrains in Vietnam. Superb combat footage records the war as it raged both in the countryside and in the cities of Saigon and Hue during the Tet Offensive of 1968.

programme.title: The Concise History of WWII
programme.desc: This 3-part program concludes with the liberation of the concentration caps and the arrests and trials of the surviving Nazi leaders for war crimes. The end of the Second World War.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom go on a Texas road trip, and absorb the very best of its Southern Hospitality. In Dallas they taste an array of delights offered at the State Fair of Texas. They learn about ranching and how to cook and eat like a real cowboy, and learn the secret behind Austin's best BBQ.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Texas

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane shares how shopping for, cleaning and cooking greens is easy and accessible. She visits her 96-year-old cousin's garden, this vibrant produce may hold the key to her longevity. In the kitchen, Diane prepares a green storm and sips a surprising elixir from cooked greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. She discusses modern nutrition's alignment with Pythagorean principles and chats with Prof. John Wilkins on Ancient Greek foods and medicines.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Rotisserie-smoked chicken with root vegetables; bourbon brown sugar pork loin; brisket; smoke-roasted pears.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - ABC's of Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Some of the world's greatest poultry dishes owe their soulful character to wood smoke. Find out how to master the fundamentals of smoking poultry-from curing and brining to smoking in charcoal smokers and pellet grills. Plus, discover how to electrify barbecue sauce with chipotle (smoked jalapeño) chilies.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: This show explores a region you don't normally associate with smoking: Asia. From Chinese char siu pork to smoky tangerine flan, learn to create a unique fusion of Asian barbecue and American wood smoke.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Asian Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Ribs epitomize barbecue, combining well-marbled, rich-tasting meat with the primal pleasure of eating with your bare hands. Embark on a rib world tour from St. Louis to Chinatown. Plus, learn how to build an onion bomb that explodes with flavor.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Raichlen on Ribs

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Find out how to apply classic ham curing and smoking techniques to anything, from spareribs to turkey legs, to create dishes that are anything but traditional. Plus, learn to make ham in a hurry and an eye-popping bacon dessert.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Ham Sessions

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Wake up to smoky breakfasts! Discover four smoky twists on bacon, hash, and more for a flavorful start.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Rise and Smoke: Breakfast Hits the Smoker

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie serves up her street food star supreme sandwich, Shawarma. Succulent, spicy, saucy, shaved off a rotisserie spit, Shawarm is one of Lebanon's most famous street-food stars! Julie shares her special tips, tricks and techniques on how-to make her signature street food star, Shawarma, right at home so you can simply re-create her recipes in your very own kitchen and NO rotisserie spit needed.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Street Food Star, Shawarma

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: An extraordinary eggplant extravaganza Lebanese-style! Julie shares some of her favorite most famous Lebanese eggplant recipes freshly sourced straight from Mama's Glorious Garden. From simple and sophisticated to earthy and exotic, eggplants are excellent selections for sauces, spreads, soups, stews, stuffed and even pickled eggplant too.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Eggplant Extravaganza

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Ciudad Juárez, Pati joins in with a group of Pachuco dancers, who are passionately preserving this distinctive Prohibition-era culture's traditions. Together they head to the iconic Kentucky Bar, rumored to be the birthplace of the margarita. Later, she savors an icon of Juárez's food scene, the burrito, at Burritos El Compa where the Olivares are keeping their family legacy alive.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: For the indigenous Rarámuri people, long-distance running through Chihuahua's majestic Copper Canyon is a way of life. Pati meets the Moreno brothers, who are famous for winning ultramarathons. In Huetosachi, community leader María Monarca teaches Pati about the art of cooking with corn in Rarámuri cuisine, from nixtamalization to a traditional dish known as "chacales."

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati journeys to Casas Grandes to experience the preserved foods, or "conservas," that sustained people during the Mexican Revolution. She meets a family that has lived for generations at Hacienda de San Diego, Mexico's "White House" for a day after the battle of Casas Grandes, including Diana Acosta and her mother, Sara Ramírez, who still preserves food the way they did during the war.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati saddles up for an exhilarating ride into the heart of Chihuahua's ranch and rodeo life. She gets a lesson in roping and riding from rodeo champion Ricardo "Bubba" Nevárez and his friends, then is invited to a post practice carne asada. She also meets Chihuahua's most influential cattle rancher, Álvaro Bustillos, at his Rancho El Arroyo, where the ranch cook serves up some cowboy delicacies.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Casas Grandes, Pati rides in style with local art curator Mayte Luján in her 1960s Cadillac. Mayte owns a bed and breakfast, Las Guacamayas, where she invites Pati into the kitchen to make chile con queso in impossibly soft flour tortillas. Later, Pati learns about another tasty export from Chihuahua, pecans, at Gustavo Vázquez's farm, where his family has been growing them for generations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culture of mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany. Mostly, she's after what they're best known for around Mexico, their cheese! She sees their traditional cheese-making process at Pampas Cheese Factory, the holder of the Guinness World Record for largest Mennonite cheese. Then she tries another local culinary innovation, Mennonite pizza.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In one of Chihuahua's most remote areas, Guachochi, Pati shares a traditional Rarámuri meal with community leaders Alejandro Hernández and Margarita González, who advocate for land rights, political representation, and cultural preservation. At Kokoyome, a sustainable ranch in the Sinforosa Canyon, she learns about organic farming practices in the region.

Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

In "Don't Fall," an innocent camping trip turns deadly, and in "Her Only Living Son," a mother must deal with the child from hell.

Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

programme.title: The Frighteners
programme.desc: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. programme.title: The Bone Crushing Kid
programme.desc: Sung (Chin Lung) is a young man who is ambitious to make his name in a theatrical troupe. The leader of the troupe is unimpressed with Sung. Sung responds by studying kung fu from an old master of the monkey style and soon becomes an expert however his new master is also the sworn enemy of the Cross fists master (James Tien) .Now Sung has a new fight on his hands.

programme.title: Last Battle of Yang Chao
programme.desc: 1645: forces loyal to the Ming are fast losing out to the Ching (Manchu). Treacherous quisling Shu Ting Kao betrays Captain Sher and takes him prisoner, as per the (Ching) emperor's orders. Sher's loyal comrades include Yuen, who is the daughter of a general recently killed in battle. Yang Chao is overrun, but Sher's comrades disguise themselves as Ching soldiers to rescue him.

programme.title: 10 Brothers of Shaolin
programme.desc: The martial-arts action film 10 Brothers of Shaolin tells the tale of ten specially trained fighters, five monks, five laymen, who have been taught their skills in order to protect Master Chu, who needs all the help he can while attempting to bring down the Ming's.

programme.title: Fly Dragon Mountain
programme.desc: A famous swordsman is out to revenge the death of his mother, but he kills the wrong man. Realizing his terrible mistake, he tries to find the real culprit for his sake and for the sake of the wrongly killed man's daughter.

programme.title: Lady Constables
programme.desc: Two female and one male (the strong, silent type) constables compete to recapture the Night-Shining Pearl, stolen by the Four Chiefs, who are led by the treacherous White Haired General Coldwater Tiger.

programme.title: Young Hero of Shaolin
programme.desc: Young Hero of Shaolin is about legendary martial artist, Fong Sai Yuk. From an early age, Fong is raised to study martial arts, and trained by his martial artist mother before entering Shaolin Temple. Fong becomes invulnerable.

programme.title: Martial Hero
programme.desc: The story is about a humble man known as the Canton Kid, who just happens to have extraordinary kung fu talent. When the Town Triads team up with a warlord they bring the town to its knees, the Canton kid steps in to restore the peace.

programme.title: 52 Masters

programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: KYOKUSHIN-KAN KARATE with Tom Callahan

programme.title: Dynamite Shaolin Heroes: See Shaolin Dynamite Heroes-Sho Kosghi Ninja Theatre 5
programme.desc: From the ashes of the Ming Dynasty come the dynamite Shaolin heroes, wading through patriots and warring government agents to try and keep the country from falling apart. But there is a mysterious lotus kung fu master at large, and can their mysterious skills overcome this deadly challenge? Without warning, they will seek out and destroy the world's most dangerous villains with their explosive kicks and punches!

programme.title: Kung Fu Genius

programme.title: Thundering Ninja
programme.desc: A Ninja Organization and the C.I.A. are fighting each other for the plans of a missile.

programme.title: Call Me Dragon

Vigilantes Inspector Big Dragon (Bruce Liang), Little Mouse, and Black Cat plan to bring Yum Kung Ho and his evil empire to its knees, but face fierce opposition in the deadly Panther, who has the stolen pearls sought after by Big Dragon and his new ally a deadly China doll named Mei Ling.

programme.title: Kagemusha Oda Nobunaga
programme.desc: As a feared warlord's power grows, so do his enemies. To reduce the risk of assassination, an impersonator is chosen to make appearances, against the warlord's own wishes. The is the story of the "shadow warrior" aka kagemusha.

programme.title: Warriors of Kung Fu

programme.desc: Mientras Amado se prepara junto a todos sus hombres para detener el ataque terrorista a Estados Unidos, Aurelio se mueve inesperadamente, cuando reconoce la voz de Corina. Casasola miente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los árabes eliminan al espía de los Casillas. Amado descifra el mensaje del asesino, que le da claves del lugar del ataque terrorista, y lo amenaza de muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un golpe de estado, Terán huye de Los Pinos y contacta al Cabo. Él lo busca en su avión privado y le exige la libre entrada a sus gatilleros. Amado deduce el blanco de los árabes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas sorprenden a los árabes. Rescatan a Casasola y Maldonado y encierran al cabecilla. Impiden que un misil impacte en EE. UU. El Chema se adueña de las narcotienditas en México.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Viva de milagro y huyendo de Baltasar Ojeda, la Doña llega a México y se une a Amado para enfrentarlo, poniendo en riesgo a los Casillas. El Chema se propone desenmascarar al doble de Aurelio.
programme.sub-title: La Doña y Amado son aliados

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado decide salir a un operativo con la Doña y Diana, pero ella decide no ir. Altagracia manipula a Águila Azul. Anaya comete otro crimen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del operativo para cazar y matar al enemigo que tienen en común, Altagracia seduce a Amado. Diana llama a su familia para advertirles que redoblen la seguridad.
programme.sub-title: La Doña y Amado se besan

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de dos emboscadas, explosiones y tiroteos, Amado enfrenta a Baltazar Ojeda. Milena besa a Rutila. Los Casillas secuestran a Anaya. El Pulque está feliz con Alba.
programme.sub-title: El duelo de Amado y Ojeda

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de muchos años, el Chema se reencuentra con Rutila y trata de seducirla. Diana espera el ataque de los colombianos y Amado decide asistirla en el operativo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Por aire y por tierra, Amado y Diana defienden con armas y granadas el rancho Ahumada. Rutila le dice al Chema que debe consultar con la familia si quiere hacer un pacto que acabe con el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La Doña lavará la fortuna de los Casillas a través de sus empresas constructoras. Diana, renuente, termina aceptando que trabaje para ellos. Carla denuncia a Terán y él manda a matarla.
programme.sub-title: La Doña pacta con los Casillas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila debe convencer a su familia de que la alianza con el Chema es una buena idea. Además, pelea con Javi al saber que estuvo con su ex.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para declararle la guerra a su enemigo en común, el Cabo, los Casillas pactan con el Chema. Javi estará al mando. La fiscal evita que la secuestren junto a Carla. Terán emprende su huida.
programme.sub-title: El Cabo fuera vivo o muerto

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Castillo pone a Terán tras las rejas y le jura que pagará por todos sus crímenes, en especial, por el de Mayra, su novia. El Cabo embaraza a sus mujeres y ambas se niegan a tener los bebes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para proteger al cartel de Casillas, Amado se entrega a la justicia con la condición de ser procesado en México. Diana promete sacarlo de prisión. El Cabo huye.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mientras Doña Alba lucha por revivir a Aurelio, los Casillas se apoderan de la ciudad para intentar liberar a Amado. Se alían con enemigos para enfrentar a los gobiernos de México y EE. UU.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Gobierno tiene rodeados a los Casillas, pero ellos no son presa fácil y les muestran a quienes pretenden eliminarlos que son indestructibles. Pío trama su venganza contra Súper Javi.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María contrata a unos actores vestidos de policía para intimidar a su hijo descarriado, pero todo resulta mal. Zoraida se da cuenta de que York finge accidentes para cobrar la indemnización.
programme.sub-title: Ilusiones rentadas; Instinto para dinero fácil

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Cándida le roban el auto en el garaje de la tienda donde trabaja y la despiden, ahora demanda a la exjefa. Javier acusa a Naomi de los destrozos en su casa y la aparición de drogas.
programme.sub-title: El costo del viaje; Locura en casa móvil

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lenin ordena desconectar a su mujer con muerte cerebral y se va a EE.UU., pero ella vive para reclamar lo suyo. Carlos construye una familia virtual y le da más valor que a su familia real.
programme.sub-title: Muerte cerebral; Fantasía de play station

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Detienen a Conni por tráfico de marihuana, su esposo puso la droga en su equipaje y ella no lo sabía. Andrea es un transexual que demanda a Eliza, dueña de un hotel, por discriminación.
programme.sub-title: Contrabando de pasto; Intolerancia a los trans

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raymond es cantante, pero no quiere cumplir su contrato con la productora porque en lugar de promover su música lo usan para vender drogas. Lucí­a dice que no en plena boda y estafa al novio.
programme.sub-title: Mafia en el género; Loca por casarme

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlett busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Steven sale de Colombia, huye de su familia homofóbica y trae dinero de dudosa procedencia. Por otro lado, Alexa desea morirse porque sufre cáncer de médula y la donante es su mamá.
programme.sub-title: Trampa para deportar; Perdidos en locura

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lleva a una pasajera a la policía, la detienen y pierde la custodia de su criatura. Una pareja busca un donante de semen para tener un hijo, pero ahora una de ellas tiene relaciones con él.
programme.sub-title: La mala intención; Engaño con contrato

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Wilson demanda a Nubia, la esposa de su padre fallecido, por falsificar el testamento: la acusa de asesina. Janet cambia su imagen con las cirugías que paga Abraham, pero él se siente estafado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo sufrió un infarto cerebral y tiene distonía muscular. Ahora tiene una novia y quiere independizarse vendiendo la casa que tiene con su hermana para comprarse un apartamento. Magdalena y su pareja graban un vídeo sexual y por descuido termina en las redes.
programme.sub-title: Ladrona de sueños; Expuesta como una cualquiera

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vanessa es taxista y transmite en vivo desde su auto, Luz la demanda por arruinarle la vida al manipular una grabación. Alejandra quiere emanciparse porque su mamá se enamoró de su pareja.
programme.sub-title: Twitch Prime; El novio de mi hija

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deja a sus gemelas con una amiga por 15 días, pero regresa a los dos años. Glenda tiene una productora pornográfica donde los clientes se convierten en actores, una de las esposas la acusa.
programme.sub-title: Volver a ser madre; La caridad del cobre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fue testigo de un supuesto abuso sexual y ahora los involucrados la amenazan. Siente que unos fantasmas la atacan y violan dentro de la casa que compró, por eso quiere devolverla.
programme.sub-title: Venganza sucia; Mi casa me enloquece

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana, al sufrir precariedades por la crisis venezolana, se ve obligada a dejar a su hijo con Mónica. También, Radel es un chico muy comelón que avergüenza a su novia cuando salen de fiesta.
programme.sub-title: Por Maduro perdí a mi hijo; El lambón

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gabriela pide una orden de alejamiento para su ex, asegura que esta se enamoró de Elsa, un dispositivo inteligente modificado. José exige la custodia de su hija, la madre la pone en peligro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lázara demanda a Perla por hacer pornografía con su madrina, una anciana que padece Alzheimer. Un pastor muere en los brazos de su amante quien, públicamente, revela un gran secreto.
programme.sub-title: En el nombre del señor; El santo pecador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Débora es adicta a los casinos y está en la lista de ludópatas, su esposo busca administrar su dinero. Ernesto solicitó servicios de una chica para que lo cuide, ella dice que no está enfermo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Demanda a sus "roommates" por su mal comportamiento, pero ahora no tiene un lugar donde vivir. Tiene relaciones con una chica que resultó ser una de sus alumnas, ella está obsesionada con él.
programme.sub-title: Guerra de las roommates; Alumna acosadora

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Le pide a su padre que entregue su licencia de conducir porque se comporta de forma agresiva cuando maneja. José no acepta que le gusta tener relaciones con hombres, por eso los golpea.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonella es una menor en prisión preventiva que viene a pedirle la emancipación a sus padres para poder donarle su hígado a la hija de la mujer que ella asesinó. Sus padres se niegan porque puede morir en la operación debido a su alergia a la anestesia. Gerardo es un pastor evangelista que tiene un hijo que supuestamente tiene el don de sanidad y recibe mensajes del señor; pero Rosmy duda de la veracidad de esa información, cree que el hombre está estafando a todos, incluso a ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cumple prisión porque ella iba escondida en su camión cuando lo detuvieron en la frontera. No le quieren pagar al payaso porque su espectáculo fue muy sexual e inapropiado para los niños.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pablo es un actor porno que busca parejas en internet para burlarse de ellas y engañar a Yesenia. También, Liz tiene sobrepeso y baja autoestima; para colmo, la acusan de robo.
programme.sub-title: Matrimonio porno; Un problema de peso

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María pide alejar a su hijo de Pedro, el padre, quien confesó sentir asco y repulsión por el niño que es discapacitado. Jennifer le facilita el sexo a su hija menor de edad, Javier la demanda.
programme.sub-title: Miedo a los monstruos; Adolescentes calientes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En el funeral de su esposo se aparece un supuesto hijo del difunto que es transexual. En el sexo, él siempre quiere usar una máquina energética que le proporciona el placer que necesitan.
programme.sub-title: Funeral de Ramón; Máquina del amor

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su mamá muere y reaparece su padrastro quien quiere parte de la herencia. Reclama por una fiesta con sexo, droga y todo tipo de ilegalidades, pelean y rompen una tubería que inunda el edificio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Abraham e Iruan se enfrentan por el contrabando de anguilas. No quiere pagar por la muerte de su empleado porque dice que en ese momento no trabajaba, sino que tenía sexo con su esposo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La familia de un hombre niega que haya sido homosexual y pelea por su herencia con la pareja gay del difunto. Irving descubre que el hijo de su esposa no es suyo y quiere anular el matrimonio.
programme.sub-title: Lo diferente no es malo; Preñada del engaño

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jésica sufre de anorgasmia y buscó ayuda en Cornelio, que ofrece servicios cuestionables de meditación orgásmica. Ángel y Patricia se separaron y ambos reclaman ser dueños de una coreografía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rosy pide que Abdul le pague lo que le debía a su difunto esposo, él se niega y acusa al fallecido. David, inquilino de Claudia, la demanda porque un balaustre se cayó cuando iba a suicidarse.
programme.sub-title: Viuda por un día; Suicidio fallido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jesús quiere la custodia compartida de su hija, pero Sandra, la madre, se niega rotundamente. En otro caso, Yadira es una mujer madura que tiene sexo con el joven Adrián, él se obsesiona.
programme.sub-title: También soy su padre; Veneno vaginal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Aldo fue raptado por los Zetas cuando migró de Cuba, su secuestrador reaparece. En otro caso, Alejandro quiere alejar a su suegra porque ella introduce a su nieta en el mundo del tarot.
programme.sub-title: Secuestrado por los Zetas; La niña tarotista

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diego y Armando trabajan en el bar de Minerva y la demandan por las condiciones de trabajo. Mariana pide la custodia de su sobrina porque la madre es una drogadicta que inventa enfermedades.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La práctica de una terapia japonesa causa un enfrentamiento entre Stephany y Samy. Gabriela fue a Venezuela a recoger unas pelucas y las de su amiga, María, tenían cocaína.
programme.sub-title: Terapia fetal; Pillada por los pelos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yenny pide el divorcio porque su esposo, Héctor, se ha vuelto adicto a los medicamentos. Rodrigo saca a su hija de su país porque fue víctima de un complot de la madre con psicólogos corruptos.
programme.sub-title: Crisis de opioides; El cartel de las ex

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jay pasa dos años en prisión por un accidente que provocó su novia, pero ella lo culpa a él. Además, Yosaida usa jengibre como estimulante sexual con su pareja, pero se enferma gravemente.
programme.sub-title: Novio peligroso; Jengibre para el amor

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Family Feud Favorites
programme.desc: "Family Feud" has seen some crazy moments over the years, so buckle up as we revisit these fan favorites.

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Veteran detective Jimmy Monroe needs money to pay for his daughter's upcoming wedding, so he decides it's time to sell his prized '52 Pafko baseball card. Before he can turn it into cash, it's stolen, and Jimmy and his partner, Paul, confront a gangster who is obsessed with sports memorabilia. First, Jimmy and Paul have to rescue a beautiful murder-witness who has the key to a fortune in offshore bank accounts.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: After his childhood buddy is murdered while visiting Detroit, rebellious cop Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) follows the leads to Beverly Hills, Calif., under the auspices of a vacation. He checks in with old friend Jenny Summers (Lisa Eilbacher) and starts to believe her boss, art dealer Victor Maitland (Steven Berkoff), might somehow be involved in the murder. However, Lt. Bogomil (Ronny Cox) of the Beverly Hills Police Department does not trust Foley, and hinders his search for evidence.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: The hard-nosed Detroit cop returns to Los Angeles to help solve another case. This time he must direct his efforts towards unraveling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady.

programme.title: The Glimmer Man
programme.desc: A former government operative renowned for his stealth, Jack Cole (Steven Seagal) is now a Los Angeles police detective. When a series of horrible murders occurs in the metro area, Cole is assigned to the case, along with tough-talking fellow cop Jim Campbell (Keenen Ivory Wayans). Although the two men clash, they gradually become effective partners as they uncover a conspiracy linked to the killings, which also involves terrorism and organized crime.

programme.title: Most Wanted
programme.desc: U.S. Sgt. Dunn (Keenen Ivory Wayans) is sentenced to death for a crime he didn't commit, but he gets a second chance when Lt. Col. Grant Casey (Jon Voight) handpicks him for a dangerous secret mission. Unfortunately, Dunn soon finds out that his assignment is a setup, and he is framed for the murder of the president's wife.
